title: Interplanetary transfer: Earth to Mars (bounded example)
summary: Hypothetical probe on a 250-day Lambert-targeted transfer departing 2026-11-14, with heliocentric N-body cruise and two trim burns, ending at the Mars 125 km interface. A Saturn V alone is not claimed to perform this mission.
expected_behaviour: The probe reaches the Mars atmospheric interface on a hyperbolic approach; capture, entry and landing are not modelled.
acceptance_checks: Final central body is Mars and final altitude is 125 km within 1 km.
Total trim delta-v is below 100 m/s.
